name: @qu/ui
description: Qu-Components: declarative, reactive Custom Elements (<qu-view>, <qu-bind>, <qu-list>, <qu-key>, <qu-if>, <qu-asset-upload>, <qu-asset>) over @qu/reactive's watch() and @qu/services' AssetService, plus small shared DOM helpers (injectStyle, renderAvatar, renderSubpage, renderFlagToggle), a shared design-token theme layer (ensureTheme), and Quniverse V4's Presentation Resolver (mountResolvedSlot() - see docs/v4-concept.md §6: an app/extension declares candidate items, this decides inline/menu/inline-then-menu/switch-case presentation). Browser-only.
